description: This source file defines the 'Option' class within the OpenCart admin model for catalog options. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving options, descriptions, values, and related data from the database. It is part of code that manages product options in the OpenCart system.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Represents the product option entity in the OpenCart catalog, providing methods to manage options and their descriptions and values.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Inserts a new option into the database, adds descriptions, and optionally adds option values.

methods.name: editOption
methods.description: Updates an existing option, manages descriptions and values, and replaces existing descriptions and values.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Deletes an option, its descriptions, and its values from the database.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific option including its description.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of options with filtering, sorting, and pagination options.

methods.name: getTotalOptions
methods.description: Returns the total count of options in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for an option in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with an option.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for options in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for an option, indexed by language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for options in a particular language.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds an option value, related descriptions, and manages optional custom IDs.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific option value and its descriptions.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves all values associated with an option, ordered by sort order.

methods.name: addValueDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for an option value in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for option values of a specific option.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptionsByOptionId
methods.description: Deletes all value descriptions associated with an option.

methods.name: getValueDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions for a specific value in all languages.
